notes: The list has no Coruscant-set card and the post predates Coruscant, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as marked '(start)' in the post: There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him, Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout, Heading For The Medical Frigate, I Feel The Conflict, Aim High, Your Insight Serves You Well and Staging Areas; these count toward the 60.
The posted section headers 'Green 3' and 'Blue3' are the weapon (3) and starship (3) section counts, not cards (Green Squadron 3 was a mis-parse); 'Objectives1' is also a header.

Posted 'Aim High (start)', 'Insight (start)' and 'Staging Areas (start)' are listed as separate cards, so they dested the single Effects Aim High, Your Insight Serves You Well and Staging Areas (Insurrection & Aim High is a Coruscant card, after this post).

Posted 'Massa Wedge (RSL)' dested Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader; 'Echo Warroom' Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room); 'Backdoor' Endor: Back Door; 'Shmi's Hut' Tatooine: Slave Quarters; 'Anakins shaggin wagon' Anakin's Podracer; 'Falcoln' Millennium Falcon; 'Tantive 4' Tantive IV.

Posted 'EPP Obi', 'EPP Leia', 'EPP Han' dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber, Leia With Blaster Rifle and Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Naked 3PO' Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'Qui-Gons Saber' Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is Reflections III, after this post); 'Weapon Lev' the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt Weapon Levitation; 'combo sense' the Light combo Sense & Recoil In Fear.
The post says the deck is 5-1 in sanctioned play (no event named) and that the 61st card would be Draw Their Fire (not counted).
